pluginTrust.section.title: Sandboxed plugins
pluginTrust.section.about: They run in a sandbox with only the permissions you allow. Every version is scanned before it is listed; a version that fails is not shown.
pluginTrust.loadFailed: Could not load the sandboxed plugin list.
pluginTrust.dialog.title: Install “{name}”?
pluginTrust.dialog.sandbox: It runs in a sandbox: anything it did not ask for is refused, and every network request is listed in the privacy ledger.
pluginTrust.scanFailed: “{name}” failed the safety scan and cannot be installed.
pluginTrust.cap.document-read: Read the note that is open
pluginTrust.cap.document-write: Change the note that is open
pluginTrust.cap.vault-read: Read any note in your vault
pluginTrust.cap.vault-write: Create and change notes in your vault
pluginTrust.cap.commands: Add commands to the command palette
pluginTrust.cap.renderer: Draw code blocks of its own language in the preview
pluginTrust.cap.storage: Store its own data on this device
